eng_blog.notes: Two Matillion blog posts meet the engineering-content threshold: Emma Wang, identified as a Software Engineer Intern, describes implementing an internal monitoring tool; Amanda Hulver and Sasha Krigel, identified as Software Engineering Interns, describe building a static-analysis reviewer for Matillion's data pipeline language. Sources: https://www.matillion.com/blog/bringing-agentic-ai-to-real-time-data-monitoring and https://www.matillion.com/blog/building-the-data-pipeline-quality-reviewer

launched_6mo.notes: Matillion announced the general availability of Maia Foundation on Google BigQuery on July 9, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/matillion-launches-maia-foundation-on-google-bigquery-302821746.html
